text:
maria: Quick sync — proposing we deprecate `client_region` and add `request_origin` + `actor_context` for audit_v2. Reason: `client_region` is noisy and ambiguous for multi-proxy customers.
jon: +1 on purpose. how does this affect KMS-wrapped actor_ids? any PII exposure we need to flag? :thinking_face:
kevin: KMS wrap unchanged, but we need to version how `actor_id` is encoded. audit_v1 used base64 JSON, audit_v2 should include `encryption_scheme: \"kms:v2\"` in metadata. we'll add a shim at read-time.
sara: Important: RBAC change — Support wants an `auditor_read` role that can read decrypted `actor_context` but not full user profile. Need to surface that in the migration docs.
maria: Good call. Plan draft: 1) introduce audit_v2 events emitted alongside v1 for 4 weeks; 2) add read-time shim to translate v1->v2 for consumers; 3) run backfill for last 90 days optionally; 4) feature-flagged customer validation endpoint.
jon: For customer validation, can we provide a dry-run API where customers POST a sample payload and get a compatibility report? That helped in prior migrations.
kevin: Yes — we'll reuse the schema-registry service. Proposed response: report on missing fields, unknown fields, and PII-risk flags (PII when `actor_context.email` present and not redacted). Example output:```json\n{\n  \"status\": \"compatible\",\n  \"missing\": [],\n  \"pii_flags\": [\"actor_context.email\"]\n}\n```
maria: Also need to update alerting: if a customer has `auditor_read` enabled, auto-send an SLA notice when we detect any unredacted PII in audit_v2 streams. Ops-bot, can we add an alert?
ops-bot: added alert `audit.pii.unredacted` -> paging on oncall after 3 occurrences in 1h. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Migration mechanics: streaming producers will emit `audit_version: 2` top-level. Consumers should ignore unknown fields. We'll maintain backwards compatibility by keeping `event_type`, `timestamp`, and `resource_id` stable.
sara: Client SDKs need to expose `AuditEvent.deserialize(..., allow_unknown=true)` and a helper `get_actor_display()` that respects RBAC/PII flags. We'll add to next SDK patch.
maria: Customer comms: draft blurb — "We are introducing audit_v2 to improve origin fidelity and reduce region churn. v1 will be supported concurrently for 30 days. Please try the compatibility API and sign off by your account rep." Thoughts?
jon: Add explicit instructions for Dedicated/Private customers: how to enable the read-shim and whether we will run backfill in their VPC or provide an export.
kevin: KMS notes for Security review: when actor_context contains `subject_token`, we must redact before logging into any third-party telemetry. Also need to confirm HSM key policy for cross-region decrypt during rollout.
sara: Vulnerability triage note: changing field names could affect alert rules that match `event_type: user.sudo`. We'll enumerate top-100 matching rules and table them in the PR.
maria: Action items: @jon to own customer dry-run API (ETA 5d), @kevin to prepare KMS HSM policy doc and shim (ETA 7d), @sara to update SDK and alert rule inventory (ETA 6d). I'll draft the customer email and rollout timeline.
jon: ack. I'll also add a canary: route 5% of audit traffic through v2-only validator to surface errors before wide rollout.
kevin: one more: add `deprecated_fields` header on the read shim so consumers can log usage of deprecated `client_region`. We can show a dashboard of remaining v1 traffic.
sara: +1 — that dashboard will help compliance signoff. also recommend we provide a sample jq transformation for customers to map `client_region -> inferred.region` during migration.
maria: example mapping snippet for docs:```bash\njq '(.request_origin // .client_region) as $origin | .request_origin = $origin | del(.client_region)' event.json\n```
jon: fine-grained rollout checklist in PR pls: schema-registry update, producer rollouts, backfill config, canary validator, SDK patch, customer comms, compliance signoff.
kevin: I'll start KMS review and add a section about key rotation impact on replayed/backfilled events.
sara: Anything blocking legal? they need to sign off on PII handling in auditor_read role. I'll ping legal after this thread.
maria: Thanks — we'll sync offline for timeline. If no objections, I'll open the RFC and assign the PRs. :thumbsup:
